integrity: A self-contained analytic compactness argument is combined with the cited original compact-UQNA density theorem. The cited public source date is the first arXiv posting. Bibliographic uniqueness is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the operator-norm closure of UQNA on c0(Gamma); it does not assert every compact operator is UQNA or finite rank, and it does not provide operator-specific numerical essential norms beyond the identity example.
title: Unique quasi norm attainment forces compactness on \(c_0(\Gamma)\)
